findings.resolution: Reworded to government data demand as a counterweight, with no claim of gains.

findings.issue: Parkiet headline only asks how markets would react to a global conflict; text attributed to it a framing of bank selling and lenders as liquid proxy.
findings.resolution: Reattributed as the question only; the lender-proxy mechanism is now the author's own inference.

findings.issue: Headline is a question (will NBP profit finance the armed forces?) but text stated funding from central-bank profit as fact.
Headline says Nvidia 'reportedly' spent $10 billion on TSMC capacity; text stated it flatly.
'most crowded position' for Iris Energy is a positioning claim with no supporting headline or card field.
findings.resolution: Replaced with 'the stretched end of the trade' (price run only).

findings.issue: Schindler profit warning headline stated as a sign construction demand is weak; beyond headline.
'strips out legacy cost' goes beyond the CNN 3G-shutdown headline.
Inferences about equity holders' views and peak-margin fears stated as fact.
'only if' overstated the CNBC headline ('if Russia has not invaded').

Checked every cited headline against sentence, src, timing windows, card numbers and source tags, curve wording, FX (none numeric), period names (FB, RTX, Mercedes-Benz Group), and invasion wording (Biden 'beginning invasion' attributed as his characterisation). No cross-date or hindsight material, no excluded IDs, no after-cutoff outcomes (RBNZ, Lowe's, TJX, Lucid, eBay treated only as pending or not as results). No fatal or major issues found.

scope_limits: Reviewed only the own-date feed headlines (not article bodies), own-date card and brief; no web access; item stamp-to-release timing for day-granular 08:00 stamps judged by headline meaning only. Cited items stamped 22 Feb (Coles, Seven Group, RBA speech n0068, Facebook Reels, Tegna, SoFi) are treated as released before 00:00 UTC on 23 Feb.

Reuters on Woolworths half-year profit and sales; Australian morning result on 23 Feb AEDT, after or at the edge of the 00:00 UTC cutoff despite 22 Feb stamp.
